market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: ETH at ~$2,380 on May 5, 2026. A dip to $1,500 by Dec 31, 2026 is a -37% drawdown over ~8 months. Such a deep decline requires major crypto/macro shock; broader market is rebounding. Historical base rate for >35% ETH decline from current level over 8 months is low but not negligible given crypto vol.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Major regulatory or macro shock could trigger steep decline
